comment: OHSidian engine tuning flags (Chromium switches). touchSlopDistance: tap tolerance, larger = taps register more easily (try 8~48 if buttons are hard to press). forceDeviceScaleFactor: 0 = follow engine default, try 1.25/1.5 if the whole UI is too small on your tablet. extraFlags: raw Chromium switches appended verbatim.
